evidence: It starts at Bottom Gordon Hut in the Leatham Conservation Area, and travels via Severn and Saxton Huts in the Molesworth Recreation Reserve, around to Top Gordon Hut and back to Bottom Gordon Hut.
The track continues on the true left for the final section along some flats and across a swing bridge back to Bottom Gordon Hut.

doubts: The first leg (Bottom Gordon Hut to Top Leatham Hut) says to cross 'the river' and 'the main river' but does not name it, so no ford is recorded there. Gordon Stream is named in the packet only later, so the first-leg river is not assumed to be it. The ford of Gordon Stream on the final leg is recorded from 'cross Gordon Stream' with no bridge mentioned at that point (a swing bridge is only mentioned at the end). Team Hut is 'not for public accommodation' but the way passes it, so it is in huts per rule 12. Severn Hut, Saxton Hut, the Severn and Saxton rivers, Oyster Creek and Boundary Stream have no packet entries, so their refs are null (T4 'Boundary' is a peak, not the stream). Between Severn Hut and Boundary Stream the route crosses an unnamed high point (1764 m) given only by grid reference, not recorded as a via. The page does not say clockwise or anticlockwise, so direction is null.
